interventions.what: text screen, BIOS data area (0040:0049, 0040:006C) and GOAL.EXE data-segment memory (DS:7B62, DS:7B64, DS:8336, DS:A9FD, the commentary ring DS:7C38 and counter DS:80EE, the score DS:9B3C, the names at [DS:9B6C], the delay byte at [DS:A923]+0x3F, two known strings) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)

a savestate is written at each read, including every read during the match, and one is loaded (Host+L) at the start (vocabulary/interventions.md lists save and load of state as I2; neutrality tested by the replays of E004, not assumed)

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process (config sha256 083897d321ed9fe50ca93bbf03ff45765c03c0f2a6e5e5df57aede499ebdc147) with C: mounted from the folder the savestate was made with, recreated from the verified release copy; GOAL run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L loads the savestate whose sha256 is given (made by `run.py make-state` at DOS time 10:02:00 on 10/04/2026, DOS read-back '10/04/2026\n10:01:59\n': the captain screen of the next match); polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it (aa572cf7fca9442f0df10a36a08f5a8f41057e833895ab1ac8c5df0e91bf2000); DOS clock of this session not set (the restore brings the state's own BIOS ticks, F004)
